title: Cycles fix through recipe R3 (hub surface, compile-gated)
summary: cycles --fix --hub-surface writes recipe R3 through the compile gate: build before and after, rollback, re-index and verify
intro: Read this when a circular group is a star around one hub form and you want the hub-surface recipe (R3) written with the same safety as the planner's fix: the project is built before and after the edit and rolled back byte-identically if it does not compile. Since 1.52 R3 is the default wherever it breaks the group (--fix, --plan --apply, --causes --format json); --no-hub-surface restores the planner, --hub-surface asks for R3 by name.
